source.directorySummary: Implements the delete/remove workspace file command via a CLI definition, a workspace-scoped filesystem handler that validates and removes targets, and an adapter that bridges CLI/web inputs to handler execution and web tree rendering.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapts the delete command by validating the path argument, resolving the workspace root, delegating to handleDeleteCommand, and returning either an error/confirmation string or a refreshed web tree via renderTreeForWeb.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Defines the delete subcommand (alias remove) with required path argument and optional --tree-dir, --ext, and --expanded web UI options.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Implements handleDeleteCommand to validate and normalize workspace-relative paths, reject root/escape/missing targets, and delete the target with rmSync returning normalized relativePath and parentDir.

summary.value: Implements the delete/remove workspace file command via a CLI definition, a workspace-scoped filesystem handler that validates and removes targets, and an adapter that bridges CLI/web inputs to handler execution and web tree rendering.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Destructive-mutation leaf in the filesystem-operations family under the plugins/file/commands aggregation. Invoked via the centralized handleFile dispatcher fan-out, it follows the shared validate-containment → execute → adapt lifecycle of sibling create/edit/rename/view commands; its irreversible rmSync effect is gated by shared workspace-root containment, and it closes the loop via parentDir-driven web tree reconciliation rather than participating in bottom-up, git, or transfer workflows.

files.adapter.ts: CLI/web boundary adapter for delete; implements the standard file-command adapter contract — validates path presence, resolves workspace root via shared helpers, delegates to handler, and branches to CLI confirmation/error strings versus renderTreeForWeb refresh to keep web UI in sync after mutation.
files.definition.ts: Commander declaration that registers the delete/remove alias and required path plus shared web projection options (--tree-dir/--ext/--expanded); defines the invocation contract consumed by the central dispatcher and adapter to scope post-delete tree rendering consistently with other file commands.
files.handler.ts: Containment-enforced filesystem primitive for the folder; centralizes workspace-relative normalization and hard rejects for root/escape/missing before rmSync, returning relativePath/parentDir to support adapter error handling and tree anchoring — the safety pattern shared with other mutating file operations.
